items: 1F plus the boom you ruled (heard, not seen): the film, then Maddie on the tannoy, a muffled boom and falling dust, Derek at the periscope sees the smoking wreck, then Maddie: 'Right. I'll come back tomorrow.' and she goes.
One new line of mine: "Oh, and... thought you'd want to hear this bit for yourselves." Note it if you want other words.

replies.q2: Done: NEW OBJECTIVE: SUSTAIN ORGANIC LIFE. I'll show it as KILL MODE flipping to that line on the same HUD (no strike-through) unless you say otherwise.
